mapper.sql: id, herb_code, herb_name, latin_name, alias_name, category, medicinal_part, efficacy, description, status, create_time, update_time, deleted
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO herb_species ( herb_code, herb_name, latin_name, alias_name, category, medicinal_part, efficacy, description, status, create_time, update_time, deleted ) VALUES ( #{herbCode}, #{herbName}, #{latinName}, #{aliasName}, #{category}, #{medicinalPart}, #{efficacy}, #{description}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{deleted} )
mapper.update: UPDATE herb_species SET herb_name = #{herbName}, latin_name = #{latinName}, alias_name = #{aliasName}, category = #{category}, medicinal_part = #{medicinalPart}, efficacy = #{efficacy}, description = #{description}, status = #{status}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM herb_species WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0

SELECT
FROM herb_species WHERE herb_code = #{herbCode} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT
FROM herb_species WHERE deleted = 0 AND ( herb_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR alias_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT
FROM herb_species WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1 ORDER BY create_time DESC
